last_sync.summary: The Custom firmware build workflow can now build from a selected source branch or an exact source commit instead of always using master. The builder tooling is checked out from the trusted workflow revision and kept separate from the selected firmware source, and the package manifest records the requested branch. The on-demand build page is updated to describe the new source inputs and the limits that apply.

decisions.rationale: The manual Custom firmware build workflow gains two optional inputs: source_ref (a raw branch name, default master) and source_sha (an optional full 40-character lowercase commit SHA). The workflow first checks out the trusted builder tooling from the workflow revision, validates the selectors, then checks out the selected firmware source, so builder scripts and policies no longer come from the branch being built. A requested SHA must match the checked-out HEAD or the run fails. The package manifest now records the requested branch as refs/heads/<branch> instead of a detached-HEAD null. Builders who need a specific branch or commit can now use the workflow; anyone relying on the previous fixed-master behavior should note that the default is still master. The build still does not flash an ECU and is not hardware validation.
evidence: custom-firmware-build.yaml adds source_ref (default master) and source_sha (default '') workflow_dispatch inputs

custom-firmware-build.yaml adds 'Check out trusted builder tooling' at github.sha and copies misc/firmware_builder to $RUNNER_TEMP before 'Check out selected firmware source' with ref: ${{ inputs.source_sha || inputs.source_ref }}
custom-firmware-build.yaml 'Capture source revision' fails with 'Source revision mismatch' when INPUT_SOURCE_SHA is set and differs from HEAD
pipeline.py adds _validated_source_ref requiring a canonical refs/heads/<branch> ref and a new --source-ref argument; manifest source.ref uses it when provided
